notes.title: From Nava Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The demo for From Nava is available now![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939803/dcd75832417e82dcc9be4c0c96e42cc96c4f6564.gif[/img]

Try out the first parts of the game today. We also have a feedback form, so please fill it out. Your responses are greatly appreciated!

Feedback Form: https://forms.gle/eoQ8HH7LpBfnwBU4A

Stay tuned for more details, including the release date, of the free release of the game soon!

Follow our socials (@navalabsgames) for more information as well. See you there!
